channel.title: Custom Monitoring on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Custom Monitoring on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Custom Monitoring Dashboard
item.description: This section describes how to create a custom monitoring dashboard. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the Monitoring Management permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles. You need to configure the application running in the container to expose monitoring metrics that comply with the Prometheus specification at a certain service endpoint.

item.title: View Custom Monitoring Dashboards
item.description: This section describes how to view custom monitoring dashboards. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the Monitoring Viewing permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the Monitoring Viewing permission and enter your cluster or workspace. Click Monitoring & Alerting > Custom Monitoring in the left navigation pane.

item.title: Edit Custom Monitoring Dashboard Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit the information of a custom monitoring dashboard. You can edit the alias and description of a custom monitoring dashboard. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a custom monitoring dashboard. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the Monitoring Management permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles.

item.title: Edit a Custom Monitoring Dashboard
item.description: This section describes how to edit a custom monitoring dashboard. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the Monitoring Management permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the Monitoring Management permission and go to your cluster or workspace.

item.title: Delete Custom Monitoring Dashboard
item.description: This section describes how to delete a custom monitoring dashboard. Warning A custom monitoring dashboard cannot be recovered after deletion. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster or project and have the Monitoring Management permission in the cluster or project. For more information, please refer to Cluster Roles and Project Roles.
